title: Therapeutic Closing Charge Dietary Credit
content:
Under **Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations**, meals are not prepared for a resident on leave, so the therapeutic closing daily charge carries a dietary credit keyed to the bed held as the reservation records it and to the leave's length from the departure date through the therapeutic closing entry's last day, both days counted: a leave of at least the dietary-credit minimum leave days, 4 days, takes the memory-unit dietary credit of 16.80 per day for a bed held on a secure memory care tier — a Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room or Private Secure Memory Care Room — and the standard dietary credit of 14.10 per day for a bed held on any other tier; a shorter leave takes none.

The tier looked at is the tier of the bed held as the reservation records it.

**Hypothetical cases.**

- Leave of 4 days, bed held in a Private Secure Memory Care Room: 16.80 per day.
- Leave of 4 days, bed held in a Private Suite with Sitting Area: 14.10 per day.
- Leave of 3 days, any room: no dietary credit.
